Eigenschaften sind kleine Boni von 0 bis: Traits are small bonuses from 0 to 5. Roll a d20 and add the bonus; 15 or more succeeds. A classic for fantasy adventures.
Eigenschaften sind Prozentwerte von 1 bi: Traits are percentages from 1 to 100. Roll a d100 at or under the value to succeed. Easy to read: 60 means a 60 % chance.
Eigenschaften reichen von −1 bis +3. Zwe: Traits range from −1 to +3. Two d6 plus value: 10 or more is a full success, 7 to 9 comes with a catch, anything lower goes wrong. Good for narrative play.
Eigenschaften reichen von 3 bis 18. Drei: Traits range from 3 to 18. Three d6 must roll at or under the value. Middle results are common, extremes rare.

Beispiel: {name} ist 45, der W100 zeigt: Example: {name} is 45, the d100 shows 38. At or under 45, so it works.
Beispiel: Die W6 zeigen 4 und 3, plus {n: Example: the d6 show 4 and 3, plus {name} 1 makes 8: success with a catch.
Beispiel: {name} ist 11, die drei W6 zei: Example: {name} is 11, the three d6 show 3, 5 and 2, 10 in total. At or under 11, so it works.
